caveats: Normal z is descriptive and is not used as a Gaussian tail probability.
The union bound uses a hypothetical 2,080,899,072 comparisons; it is not a retained-output count or an independence correction.
Threshold, length, iid-uniform model validity, and multiple-comparison accounting remain analysis choices.
A byte occupancy statistic cannot detect structure that remains binary or has not yet been decoded into the tested byte alphabet.
